title: Your body is a garden

additional: Written in the Style of the Game Disco Elysium
The boys are bad at communicating
The skills fail a lot of checks

summary:
Your gaze is drawn back to the victim’s eyes as you place your hand on her sternum to perform the Stations of the Breath. They draw you in, and suddenly you are swimming in the milky, brown orbs. You feel like you’re being pulled by some unknowable force. You catch yourself tipping forward at the last second, accidentally compressing her chest.
She seems to exhale and you breathe in the scent of flowers and rotting corpse.
-
People are dying with flowers around their corpses, and Harry is plagued with mysterious coughing fits as he tries to navigate his newly realized feelings for his partner. Complete!
